components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f2c14e; color: #0b1310; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem; font: 700 0.8rem 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2c14e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Slide Card
components.description: Pinned subject slide; selects and opens a subject.
components.html: 01Discrete Structure6 chapters
components.css: .ds-slide-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 150px; padding: 1rem 0.9rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid rgba(232,236,225,0.16); background: rgba(11,19,16,0.55); color: #e8ece1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-slide-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -7px; left: 50%; width: 34px; height: 13px; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-2deg); background: rgba(242,193,78,0.55); } .ds-slide-card:hover { border-color: #2f7d58; background: rgba(47,125,88,0.12); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-num { color: #f2c14e; font: 400 0.8rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-name { font: 700 1.25rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-count { color: #a9b7ac; font-size: 0.68rem; }

components.name: Search Input
components.css: .ds-search { background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(232,236,225,0.16); color: #e8ece1; padding: 0.2rem 0; caret-color: #f2c14e; } .ds-search:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #f2c14e; }

narrative.overview: The hub behaves like the slide deck projected before a lecture begins. A chalkboard-green field, a projector bloom, pinned subject slides, and a numbered syllabus make the visitor's job obvious: pick a subject and open its notes. One warm accent marks the active choice.
keyCharacteristics: Chalkboard ground with faint dust texture
Condensed display type against humanist body
Numbered syllabus paired with pinned slides
One yellow accent for the active decision

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears only on the active choice and its action.

rules.name: The Heading Carries It Rule
rules.body: No kicker or eyebrow sits above a heading.

dos: Do reserve yellow for the active decision.
Do use drawn SVG marks with one consistent stroke weight.
donts: Don't add a kicker above the display headline.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons.
Don't introduce rounded corners or gradient text.
